captions.caption: A green forklift carries a large tan power unit toward the open rear ramp of a Chinook helicopter.
The forklift continues its approach to the helicopter on the rocky ground.
The forklift maneuvers the power unit closer to the helicopter's cargo hold.
Personnel assist in guiding the forklift as it enters the back of the helicopter.
The front of the forklift moves into the shade of the helicopter's interior.
The heavy equipment is partially inside the helicopter's cargo bay.
A side view shows the forklift operator carefully positioning the load inside.
The operator adjusts the forklift controls from inside the vehicle's cabin.
A soldier signals to the forklift operator from beside the helicopter ramp.
The forklift remains stationary as the load is secured within the aircraft.
Close-up on the forklift's mechanical arm as it holds the equipment in place.
The scene transitions to the interior of the helicopter during loading operations.
A person inside the helicopter inspects a large white shipping container.
Personnel work to secure the white container labeled GSA Contract Holder.
A soldier adjusts the straps on top of the cargo container inside the aircraft.
Another view of soldiers working around the cargo inside the helicopter bay.
A soldier points outward while managing the cargo placement.
Personnel continue to organize the items in the helicopter's cargo bay.
The soldier leans over the container to check the attachment points.
The forklift's forks are visible supporting the equipment from the side.
Personnel coordinate the placement of the heavy generator unit inside.
A view from inside shows a soldier working near the base of the equipment.
The soldier secures a strap to the side of the tan generator unit.
Personnel ensure the load is stable before the forklift retracts its forks.
The soldier stands up after finishing the task inside the helicopter.
A close-up shot of the forklift's mechanical arm assembly.
A marine watches as the forklift begins to back away from the cargo.
The forklift slowly reverses out of the helicopter's rear ramp.
The empty forks of the forklift emerge from the helicopter's cargo area.
The forklift continues to back up across the rocky desert terrain.
The camera pans as the forklift moves away from the aircraft.
The forklift makes a turn while backing away from the loading area.
The forklift operator drives the vehicle across the rocky ground.
The forklift moves further away into the open desert field.
A wide shot shows the forklift driving off-screen past the aircraft.
The helicopter's rotors continue to spin while it sits on the ground.
The forklift passes by other military vehicles in the desert background.
A soldier stands near the tail of the helicopter during the operation.
The helicopter remains stationary as loading procedures continue.
Dust kicks up from the ground due to the rotor wash of the aircraft.
Marines are seen carrying gear toward the back of the aircraft.
A group of marines with large backpacks approaches the open helicopter ramp.
Marines carry various bags and cases into the helicopter's cargo hold.
Soldiers walk quickly into the helicopter with their personal equipment.
More personnel enter the aircraft carrying heavy backpacks and gear.
A marine carries a long equipment case toward the helicopter ramp.
The last few marines in the group board the helicopter for transport.
The scene transitions to a CH-53 helicopter on a dusty field.
A CH-53 helicopter begins to lift off from the desert ground.
Dust is kicked up as the helicopter rises slowly from the surface.
The helicopter hovers just above the ground during its initial ascent.
The CH-53 gains a bit more altitude while staying level in the air.
The helicopter continues its steady upward movement into the sky.
Personnel on the ground watch as the helicopter takes off.
The aircraft moves upward, revealing the surrounding desert landscape.
The helicopter continues to climb away from the landing zone area.
A high-angle shot shows the helicopter ascending further into the air.
The helicopter is now several feet above the ground during takeoff.
Ground crew members stand near a vehicle as the helicopter rises.
The helicopter moves further into the air as the sequence ends.
